# MEEHAAN Enterprise — AI Automation Agency

## What is MEEHAAN Digital?
MEEHAAN Digital is an AI automation agency that builds custom AI agents, workflow automation systems, and software products for businesses in the US, UK, and globally. Every project is delivered at a fixed price with a fixed timeline — proposals arrive within 48 hours of a discovery call, and most products are live in under 14 days.

## Core services
- Custom AI agent development (multi-agent systems, voice AI, workflow orchestration)
- Workflow automation (CRM integration, document processing, operational pipelines)
- Custom software and SaaS product development
- AI product deployment with 30-day post-launch support included

## AI Products available for deployment

### Horizontal AI Agents
Six coordinated AI agents sharing one unified context window. Covers sales intelligence, marketing intelligence, operations reporting, collections and dunning, vendor management, and a Jarvis orchestration layer. Live in under 14 days.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/horizontal-ai-agents

### Voice Intake Concierge
An always-on AI voice agent for franchise and multi-location businesses. Answers every inbound call, qualifies leads, handles intake, and routes complex cases — across every location, 24/7, without adding headcount.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/voice-intake-concierge

### Contact Center Intelligence
An AI layer deployed inside live call centre operations. Surfaces full caller context — account history, prior interactions, open issues — on the agent's screen the moment a call connects. Reduces average handle time from week one.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/contact-center-intelligence

### Legal Recovery AI
Automates debt negotiation workflows and legal process management simultaneously. The AI agent contacts debtors, presents terms, handles objections, and produces compliant documentation — without a human on every call.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/legal-recovery-ai

### Facility Operations AI
Gives field technicians conversational access to full property history and service records on any device. Also handles inbound client queries and service scheduling without a human dispatcher on every interaction.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/facility-operations-ai

### Website Builder AI
Builds, continuously optimises, and grows websites automatically. Handles design, copy, SEO, and AEO — and keeps improving post-launch without operator involvement.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/website-builder-ai

### Exit Concierge
AI operations layer for business brokers and M&A advisors. Automates prospect qualification, document collection, buyer-seller matching, and communication sequencing — so advisors focus on the conversations that close deals.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/exit-concierge

### AI-Native LMS
An adaptive learning and onboarding platform built natively on AI. Personalised learning paths, adaptive content sequencing, and AI-driven reinforcement loops built into the core architecture.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/ai-native-lms

### CaFlow — Practice Management for Accounting Firms
An end-to-end practice management platform for accounting firms in the US and UAE. Replaces TaxDome, Dext, and Karbon with one platform. Automates document collection over email and WhatsApp, tracks every compliance deadline (federal, state, VAT, UAE corporate tax, FTA), and pushes structured data directly into QuickBooks, Xero, and Zoho Books. One flat monthly price — no annual lock-in, no per-user penalty.
URL: https://www.meehaan.com/solutions/digital/products/caflow-practice-management

## How the engagement works
1. Discovery Call (free, 30 minutes) — understand your workflow and where AI fits
2. Proposal in 48 hours — fixed scope, fixed price, fixed timeline
3. Build & Iterate — weekly sprints with a demo every Friday
4. Deploy & Support — live deployment with 30 days of included post-launch support

## Pricing model
Fixed price per project. No hourly billing. Full refund if the committed deadline is missed.
